bonus.text: Want to dance salsa in Laos? The Blues Box in Vientiane runs free Thursday salsa nights, from 8:30 pm to 1 am.
Khaen music, played on a bamboo mouth organ, joined the UNESCO list in 2017. At village festivals, listeners often join in the songs and dances.
Lyon-raised Lao dancer Olé Khamchanla discovered hip-hop in 1990. In 2010 he founded the Fang Mae Khong International Dance Festival in Laos.
